product_metadata.title: Crane Adorables Ultrasonic Humidifiers for Bedroom and Baby Nursery, 1 Gallon Cool Mist Air Humidifier for Large Room or Kid's Room, Humidifier Filters Optional, Owl
features: LARGE ROOM HUMIDIFIER: Crane Adorables Ultrasonic Humidifier features an easy-to-clean, detachable bottom fill tank that holds one gallon of water− perfect for humidifying indoor spaces up to 500 square feet for 24 hours

ADJUSTABLE SETTINGS: Optional filter slot and variable controls make it easy to set the best humidity level for your room; Simply adjust as needed for multi-purpose use as a plant humidifier, baby humidifier, bedroom humidifier, or a children's room humidifier

HSA FSA ELIGIBLE ITEM: Your shopping list of FSA HSA approved products only gets healthier with our soothing humidifiers and steam inhalers that help fight cold and flu symptoms in your home or office

NURSERY ESSENTIAL: Kid-friendly automatic shut-off feature helps your little one sleep peacefully during nap time and nighttime while playful character design helps this cute humidifier fit right in with safari nursery décor, boho nursery décor, or any other baby nursery décor

ADORABLES COLLECTION: Explore our full collection of regular and mini humidifiers for babies and kids available in a variety of fun character designs to find the right large or small humidifier for your home, nursery, kid's room, or playroom
description: Get relief from cold and flu symptoms and bring wellness to your entire family with a Crane Adorable humidifier. Featuring an award winning, child friendly animal designs and top rated performance. Crane’s 1 Gal. Adorable ultrasonic cool mist humidifiers provide up to 500 sq. ft. of coverage and 24 hours of soothing moisture to help relieve the effects of dryness and congestion, helping you and your family to breathe easy and sleep through the night peacefully.
